name: Maria Baltazzi
reason: Too thin: her own site (mariabaltazzi.com) is the author page for a single self-help book on happiness, Take a Shot at Happiness (Post Hill Press, ISBN 9781637588604), with a free quiz on sojourntohappiness.com and media appearances as a guest; no courses, classes, sessions or own teaching videos, so beyond the book, the quiz and the Insight Timer link there is nothing to list. Email hello@mariabaltazzi.com is published (mailto on the home page) if the owner wants her anyway.
